resources.string: Comment missing
This marker belongs to a comment that was deleted. Remove the marker to take it out of the source, or restore the comment.
This marker belongs to no known comment. Remove the marker to take it out of the source, or create the comment from it.
Remove marker
Take the marker out of its source; highlighted words stay
Restore
Bring the comment back from the marker\'s text, or create it when it was never known
Marker removed from %1$s.
Comment restored from the marker in %1$s.
Comment recreated from the marker in %1$s.
Publishes at next Sync.
The marker id cannot name a comment.
%1$s is not a managed source.
Download sources (Sync) to resolve this marker.
The comment of the marker in %1$s exists again; the marker was kept.
The comment of the marker in %1$s already exists.
The marker is no longer in %1$s.
The marker appears %1$d times in %2$s; remove the extra copies by hand.
The marker removal in %1$s could not be verified; the file was left unchanged.
The comment\'s document was deleted, so the server does not restore it. Remove the marker instead.
The deleted comment has no valid revision; Sync and try again.
The document of %1$s is not in the Library yet; Sync before restoring this comment.
The comment could not be saved to the local sync queue.
Couldn\'t resolve the marker.
